Description: Fragments of an Aramaic Targum (translation) of Job from Qumran Cave 4, in Herodian script. This is a translation of Job, not a Hebrew copy: it renders Job 3 and Job 4-5 into Aramaic, and it is the smaller of the two Qumran Job targums (the other is 11Q10).
Significance: Evidence that Job was not only copied in Hebrew at Qumran but also translated into Aramaic for hearers or readers who needed it, centuries before the later rabbinic targums; as a translation it witnesses to interpretation of Job, not directly to the Hebrew wording.
